classification_rationale: The customer is simply asking how to arrange collection of a site cabin at the end of its rental, which is standard return logistics.

draft.reply_body:
Hello,

No problem — we can arrange the site cabin return either way: you're welcome to bring it back to the depot, or we can send someone out to collect it from site. Let us know which suits and roughly when it'll be ready, and we'll get it booked in.

We also haven't forgotten about the date change you asked about for the cement mixer trailer — we'll follow that up separately and come back to you on availability.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service

commitments.description: Arrange return of the site cabin, either by drop-off at the depot or collection from site
Follow up separately on the still-open request to change dates on the cement mixer trailer booking
